title: Ptah in your terminal — connect, ask, watch it work

slides.vo: Ptah runs in your terminal. It opens on the provider list, and the Claude tile picks up the login you already have. No API key to paste.
captions: No API key. Your existing login.

slides.vo: Switch models without leaving the session, then just ask for the work in plain language.
captions: Switch models. Ask in plain language.

slides.vo: It reads your real code, finds the webhook handler and the failure table already there, and comes back with two ways forward and the honest trade-off on each.
One orchestra, in the terminal you already live in.
captions: One orchestra, in the terminal you already live in.
